info.title: WhereWePraying Public Web Interface
info.description: Machine-readable description of the public WhereWePraying web surface. The current application is a client-side web app and does not expose an authenticated data API. Authentication scopes are documented as a reserved permission vocabulary rather than being attached to public routes.

whereweprayingOAuth2.description: Reserved least-privilege permission vocabulary for a future authenticated WhereWePraying API. No public operation currently requires OAuth.
